findings.title: exit-17 refusal permanently wedges PLANNING — no `jobs gc` ever runs in that phase, so a stranded plan-critique manifest is never reaped
exit 17 collides with the kernel exit-code registry's "brokered command refused", and the registry was not updated
`drive_implementing`'s design note still argues the duplicate guard must never live in `jobs prepare`, while `prepare` now cites that note as its authority
doctor prints "the orchid installation's own `$ORCHID_ROOT/orchid.config` is NEVER consulted", which is false whenever orchid drives itself
